notes.title: Villager's Hideout - New Mechanics and Gameplay changes
notes.content:
Power balance

 Orc must now choose between life or damage as level up
 Orc get more a lot more exp by killing villager's now
 Gate starts with more life and get more life from upgrades


Gameplay Changes

 Added teleport home stations randomly spread across the map
 Added lamps
 Added treasure chests that rewards consumable skills across the map

notes.title: Villager's Hideout - Some Bug fixes & Balancing player power
notes.content:
Power balance

 Expected time to destroy gate: 120 -> 55
 Expected time to kill orc: 420 -> 45
 Orc now gets XP based on level of villager, his own level and crit multiplier
 Orc now getting bonus xp by level of villager killed


Gameplay Changes

 Fixed tower projectile following orc forever
 Fixed tower projectiles not dying
 Fixed orc not being able to access his perk tree
 Attack Skill Buff from 0.25 -> 2
 Heal Skill from 200 -> 50%
 Added more texts to guide player

notes.title: Villager's Hideout - Some Bug fixes & Balancing player power
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes

 Big nerf to orc health
 Big buff to goblin health
 Buffed towers
 Nerfed building prices
 Made Huge balancement changes
 Raised voice chat proximity distance
 Made compass more obvious
 Added a field of view to statue
 Added "I want to be an orc" button
 Added upgrade indicator to orc statue


Bug Fixes

 Fixed orc being able to invade villager's base
 Fixed players going outside the map
 Fixed players claiming the same island
 Fixed goblin going noclip
 Fixed some islands not appearing
 Fixed upgrade indicator appearing to max level buildings

notes.title: Villager's Hideout - Big Graphical & Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes

 Added orc artifact system
 Added quest system
 Removed old boring tutorial
 Added mini-games
 Made Huge balancement changes


Graphical Changes

 Added new tower projectiles
 Added LOTS of game feel improvements
 Added shadows
 Added player outlines
 Added new animations & particles
 Fixed some font translations


Other Changes

 Added language flags for lobbies
 Added better sounds
 Some bug fixes
